name: CBT - Click Before Tick
description: Experimental Click Before Tick timing, TPS bypass and QoL controls for Android64.

enabled.name: Enable CBT
enabled.description: Enables the experimental input-timing layer. Alpha quality.

precision-ms.name: Input Precision (ms)
precision-ms.description: 0ms = no timing bias. Negative values advance the input timestamp; positive values delay it. This is an experimental timing bias, not a guarantee of physical input before hardware delivery.

extrapolate.name: CBT Extrapolate
extrapolate.description: Experimental extrapolation of the input timestamp inside the physics step.

tps.name: Physics TPS
tps.description: Experimental physics bypass target. 240 is vanilla; higher values subdivide elapsed time.

show-overlay.name: Show Overlay
show-overlay.description: Shows CBT timing and TPS status while playing.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Marks completions as test-mode while experimental timing/TPS features are active.
